subject: english

en.question: Choose the word that means the same as "happy".
en.hint: Think of how you feel on your birthday.
en.explanation: "Glad" means happy. Sad, angry and tired are different feelings.

ml.question: Choose the word that means the same as "happy".
ml.hint: പിറന്നാൾ ദിവസം നിനക്ക് എങ്ങനെ തോന്നും എന്ന് ആലോചിക്കൂ.
ml.explanation: "Glad" എന്നാൽ സന്തോഷം (happy). മറ്റുള്ളവ വേറെ വികാരങ്ങളാണ്.

en.question: Choose the opposite of "ancient".
en.hint: "Ancient" means very old.
en.explanation: "Ancient" means very old, so its opposite is "modern" (new, of today).

ml.question: Choose the opposite of "ancient".
ml.explanation: "Ancient" (വളരെ പഴയ) എന്നതിന്റെ വിപരീതം "modern" (ആധുനികം) ആണ്.

en.question: Choose the word that means the same as "big".
en.hint: An elephant is this.
en.explanation: "Large" means big. "Tiny" is its opposite.

ml.question: Choose the word that means the same as "big".
ml.explanation: "Large" എന്നാൽ വലുത് (big). "Tiny" അതിന്റെ വിപരീതമാണ്.

subject: english

en.question: Choose the opposite of "strong".
en.hint: Think of someone who cannot lift a heavy bag.
en.explanation: The opposite of "strong" is "weak".

ml.question: Choose the opposite of "strong".
ml.hint: ഭാരമുള്ള ബാഗ് ഉയർത്താൻ പറ്റാത്ത ഒരാളെ ഓർക്കൂ.
ml.explanation: "Strong" (ശക്തിയുള്ള) എന്നതിന്റെ വിപരീതം "weak" (ദുർബലം) ആണ്.

en.question: A person who repairs machines and vehicles is a ___.
en.hint: You take your bicycle or car to this person.
en.explanation: A mechanic repairs machines and vehicles.

ml.question: A person who repairs machines and vehicles is a ___.
ml.hint: സൈക്കിളോ കാറോ കേടായാൽ ഇദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ അടുത്താണ് കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നത്.
ml.explanation: യന്ത്രങ്ങളും വാഹനങ്ങളും നന്നാക്കുന്നയാളാണ് mechanic.

en.question: Fill in the blank: She is ___ honest girl.
en.hint: Say "honest" aloud. Does it start with a vowel sound?
en.explanation: "Honest" begins with a vowel sound (the h is silent), so we use "an".

ml.question: Fill in the blank: She is ___ honest girl.
ml.explanation: "Honest" എന്നതിലെ h ഉച്ചരിക്കുന്നില്ല; സ്വരശബ്ദത്തിൽ തുടങ്ങുന്നതിനാൽ "an" ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.

en.question: Fill in the blank: My pencil is ___ the box; I cannot see it.
en.hint: If you cannot see it, it must be inside.
en.explanation: "In" is used for something inside a container.

ml.question: Fill in the blank: My pencil is ___ the box; I cannot see it.
ml.explanation: ഒരു വസ്തുവിന്റെ ഉള്ളിലുള്ളതിനെ സൂചിപ്പിക്കാൻ "in" ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.

subject: english

en.question: What is the past tense of "go"?
en.hint: Yesterday I ___ to school.
en.explanation: "Went" is the past tense of "go". "Gone" is the past participle (I have gone).

ml.question: What is the past tense of "go"?
ml.hint: Yesterday I ___ to school എന്ന് പറഞ്ഞുനോക്കൂ.
ml.explanation: "go" യുടെ ഭൂതകാലം "went" ആണ്. "gone" ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നത് have/has ഒപ്പമാണ്.

subject: english

en.question: Choose the correct form: I have ___ a letter to my grandmother.
en.hint: After "have", use the past participle.
en.explanation: With "have", we use the past participle: write – wrote – written.

ml.question: Choose the correct form: I have ___ a letter to my grandmother.
ml.explanation: "have" ഒപ്പം past participle ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു: write – wrote – written.

en.question: Fill in the blank: Please ___ the light when you leave the room.
en.hint: We do this to save electricity.

ml.question: Fill in the blank: Please ___ the light when you leave the room.
ml.explanation: "Switch off" എന്നാൽ സ്വിച്ച് ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ലൈറ്റോ യന്ത്രമോ ഓഫ് ചെയ്യുക.

en.question: The phrasal verb "look after" means:

ml.question: The phrasal verb "look after" means:
ml.explanation: "Look after" എന്നാൽ ഒരാളെയോ ഒന്നിനെയോ പരിപാലിക്കുക (take care of).

ml.explanation: "child" ന്റെ ബഹുവചനം "children" ആണ്. -s ചേർക്കില്ല.

en.question: Fill in the blank: He ___ to school every day.
en.hint: With he/she/it in the simple present, add -s or -es.
en.explanation: In the simple present, "he" takes "goes".

ml.question: Fill in the blank: He ___ to school every day.
ml.hint: Simple present-ൽ he/she/it ഒപ്പം ക്രിയയിൽ -s/-es ചേർക്കണം.

en.question: Fill in the blank: This box is ___ than that one.
en.hint: We are comparing two things.
en.explanation: To compare two things we use the comparative "heavier" (+ than).

ml.question: Fill in the blank: This box is ___ than that one.
ml.explanation: രണ്ടെണ്ണത്തെ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യാൻ "heavier" (comparative) ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.

en.question: Choose the correct question tag: You are a student, ___?
en.hint: The sentence is positive, so the tag is negative, with the same subject.
en.explanation: A positive sentence takes a negative tag with the same subject and verb: "You are …, aren't you?"

ml.question: Choose the correct question tag: You are a student, ___?
ml.hint: വാക്യം positive ആയതിനാൽ tag negative ആകണം; subject ഒന്നുതന്നെ.
ml.explanation: Positive വാക്യത്തിന് അതേ subject-ഉം ക്രിയയും ചേർന്ന negative tag വരും: "You are …, aren't you?"

en.question: Fill in the blank: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
en.hint: "Look!" tells us it is happening right now.
en.explanation: For actions happening now, we use the present continuous: "are playing".

ml.question: Fill in the blank: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
ml.explanation: ഇപ്പോൾ നടന്നുകൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്ന പ്രവൃത്തിക്ക് present continuous ("are playing") ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.

en.question: "The stars danced in the sky." Which figure of speech is this?
en.hint: Can stars really dance? Who dances?
en.explanation: Giving human actions (dancing) to non-living things (stars) is personification.

ml.question: "The stars danced in the sky." Which figure of speech is this?
ml.hint: നക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾ ശരിക്കും നൃത്തം ചെയ്യുമോ? ആരാണ് നൃത്തം ചെയ്യുന്നത്?
ml.explanation: ജീവനില്ലാത്തവയ്ക്ക് (നക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾ) മനുഷ്യന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തി (നൃത്തം) നൽകുന്നത് personification ആണ്.

en.question: "He is as brave as a lion." Which figure of speech is this?
en.hint: Look for the words "as … as".
en.explanation: A comparison using "as … as" or "like" is a simile.

ml.question: "He is as brave as a lion." Which figure of speech is this?
ml.explanation: "as … as" അല്ലെങ്കിൽ "like" ഉപയോഗിച്ചുള്ള താരതമ്യം simile ആണ്.
